title: Nutty Juicy Nostalgic Moroccan Peach Stir-fry
description: A nutty and juicy Moroccan peach stir-fry with a touch of fermentation for an authentic taste experience. Kosher-friendly.

ingredients.name: Water (for steaming peaches if not already peeled)

instructions: Steep sliced almonds in hot water for about 10 minutes, then drain and set aside. Steamed peaches can be used instead of steaming if desired.
In a small pan, toast cumin seeds over medium heat until golden brown, shaking frequently to prevent burning. Transfer to a bowl.
Add olive oil to the same pan; add minced garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. Add peaches along with some water if needed and cook until they release their juices.
Fold in toasted cumin seeds, fermented vegetables, and almonds. Mix well.
Season with salt and pepper as desired. Stir-fry gently over medium heat for another 2-3 minutes to meld flavors.
Serve hot or at room temperature.
